title: Kernel-Whitening: Overcome Dataset Bias with Isotropic Sentence Embedding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy and generalization on out-of-distribution (OOD) challenge datasets (HANS, FEVER Symmetric, PAWS) compared to in-distribution test sets (MNLI, FEVER, QQP) to measure reliance on spurious correlations, annotation artifacts, and shallow heuristics (e.g., lexical overlap, structural patterns).
